name: Horses per head
note: the working stock the county holds: the capacity desk's herd and the maker's breeding stock; oracle 1.31 (Dunbartonshire 1900) to 8.25 (Northumberland 1900)

name: Horses per head since 1750
inputs: as horses.per.head; the run's genesis record
note: oracle -0.68 to 0.83

name: Horses against their equilibrium
measure: ln(heads / heads* at the params in force)
inputs: as horses.per.head; oracle unit 1g at the county's params in force (worldgen's oracle_gap)
note: capital's lag (D-G14): the mirror's long run reaches -0.33 (Glamorgan 1863); never fed back (R13)

name: Horses against the desk's own target
note: the desk orders to close 2 delta of this gap a year; the mirror's long run: -0.14 to +0.06

name: Fodder's price in rent
unit: land-service units per unit of fodder
note: at rest omega*b: oracle 0.2625 to 0.680

name: Horse price over its replacement cost
measure: p_K*(1 - delta*a_I/kappa) / c_m at posted prices (the maker's markup)
inputs: MarketLine.price and ::trades (horse; fodder; labour; land); Sim::param(county.C.horse.*; horse.*)
note: no value on a tick when no horse traded: an idle market's price is not a valuation (O47; O54); the maker withholds below psi 0.25; its lowest is 0.981 in the mirror's long run and 0.212 in its battery

name: Horse-day markup over full cost
note: the scarcity rent that builds the herd (D-G14's quasi-rent); the mirror's long run: -0.076 to +0.233

name: Land to fodder
note: oracle 0.484 (West Riding 1901) to 0.728 (Norfolk 1801)

name: Land to the working stock
measure: (fodder.land * fodder made + horse.land * heads made) / T_c
note: fodder and pasture together: oracle 0.570 to 0.857; the rest is homes (h per basket)

name: Ticks the maker withheld
measure: ticks in the trailing 52 in which the maker's markup was below psi
note: the reservation (IDLE-SPEC; decision 253); 0 in every county on the mirror's history (WORLD-V2 6)

name: Ticks the horse market was idle
measure: ticks in the trailing 52 in which no horse traded
note: O80's idle ticks: orders stop in a glut by the order rule's design; 0 on the mirror's history

name: Wage in baskets
inputs: MarketLine.price (labour; good; land) at the county's node; Sim::param(county.C.space)
note: the real wage the paper's households face; narrow by construction (WORLD.md 5.2)

name: Wage in goods
note: the fork's rising branch; with Appendix B's shape it cannot pass 1/(g0 + g1/(k+1))

name: Wage in land
note: the fork's falling branch; the oracle's v

name: Land share
note: T_c and L_c are the cleared volumes; 1 - share.labour until interest exists

name: Labour share
note: the oracle's labor_share at rest

name: Automation frontier
unit: share of tasks done by machines
note: the desk's planned technique; x* at rest

name: Participation
note: N_a/N; N per tick through the registry's site conversion

name: Output per head
note: N is population/25k a tick so this is proportional to output per person

name: Horse-day price in rent
note: at rest O + delta*p_K/kappa, which is v1's p_m (the collapse): oracle 0.432 to 1.230

name: Relief burden
reference: 1 = the rent roll no longer covers support
note: the oracle's N*P_s/(r*T); above 1 the provider cannot pay

name: Relief shortfall
note: 0 at the oracle and in every county on this history; it shows only under an abrupt edit

name: Rationing
measure: max over the county's rationing lines of 1 - filled/requested
inputs: RationLine (requested; filled) at the county's node
note: G0 logs onsets and this is the level; 0 at the oracle and at most 0.032 at the first tick of each year of the run to 1901; an abrupt edit shows beyond the scale

name: Ticks without trade
measure: ticks in the trailing 52 in which one of the county's five markets that must trade did not trade
note: the horse market is counted apart (idle.horse) since its orders stop in a glut by design (O80); not the probe's dead tick; 0 on the mirror's history

name: Gap to the county's own equilibrium
inputs: P2.2a's observables but the horse market's volume (HORSES-SPEC 7.1) and oracle unit 1g at the county's params in force (worldgen's oracle_gap)
note: bands: 1 the tolerance, 10 is 1% in log, 100 is 10%, 1000 is 100%; most counties run 5-20% from equilibrium in log in the mirror and capital settles over decades (D-G14); never fed back (R13)

name: Wage against its equilibrium
inputs: MarketLine.price (labour; land); oracle unit 1g at the params in force (worldgen's oracle_gap)
note: the signed gap of the fastest price; the mirror's long run: -0.031 to +0.416

name: Wage in baskets since 1750
inputs: as wage.baskets; the run's genesis record
note: a change lens: every level lens has one

name: Population (N)
note: the history's scarcity lever; recorded by G0's Extractor

name: Land services (T)
note: rents via T: enclosure; improvement; coal; sites

name: Task cost scale (eta)
note: task automation via gamma

name: Land per horse-day (b)
note: the fold of rule A's land: fodder's omega*b and the pasture's (1 - omega)*b, worn; rents via coal, canals and railways; b itself is not registered (decision 328)

name: Labour per horse-day (lambda)
note: the fold of a head's labour, worn per horse-day: recursive automation by machine tools; lambda itself is not registered (decision 328)

name: Work cost scale (chi_max)
note: exit
